# AMC Bento Launchpad

<!-- Generated by tools/build-templates.mjs from template.json. Do not edit by hand. -->

**List Template** for Universal Theme · direction: smart · APEX 23.1+ · v1.0.0

A bento launchpad: list entries become tiles of mixed sizes with an oversized tilted icon, a description and a live metric, and the grid and every tile recompose with container queries as the region changes width.

**Use it for:** Home pages and workspace launchpads with 4 to 12 entries, where each destination has a short description and a number worth showing (open orders, overdue invoices, pending approvals).

## Install

- **APEX 23.1 to 25.x (or any version, through the Builder):** App Builder > your app > Shared Components >
  Export/Import > Import `dist/legacy/amc_tpl_bento_launchpad.sql` (Component Export). It creates the
  template in Universal Theme and its Static Application File(s) in `amc-templates/`.
- **APEX 26.1+ (APEXlang):** copy `dist/apexlang/shared-components/themes/universal-theme/list-templates/amc-bento-launchpad.apx` and
  `dist/apexlang/shared-components/static-files/amc-templates/` into the app, add the entries from
  `dist/apexlang/static-files.snippet.apx` to `shared-components/static-files.apx`, then run the apexlang gates.

## Use

Create or pick a List (Shared Components > Lists), add a **List** region and set **Appearance > List Template** to **AMC Bento Launchpad**. In APEXlang: `componentAppearance { listTemplate: @amc-bento-launchpad }`.

List template for a List region. User Defined Attribute 1 sets the tile size: wide (two columns), tall (two rows) or large (two by two, filled with the primary color); leave it empty for a normal tile, and other values are ignored. Attribute 2 is a short description and Attribute 3 a metric such as '128' or 'SAR 4.2M' (use an application item substitution to keep it live). The grid uses 1 column below 480px of region width (tiles become rows), 2 columns up to 760px, 4 up to 1180px and 6 beyond; tall, wide and large tiles switch their inner layout to show a big metric. While one tile has the pointer the others step back. Everything works with the keyboard in list order, with a visible focus ring. Template options: Tinted tiles, Compact rows, Mono large tile, Hide big icons.

## List entry attributes

| Attribute | Meaning |
|---|---|
| A01 | Tile size |
| A02 | Description |
| A03 | Metric |

## Template options

| Option | Class | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| Tinted tiles | `amc-TBentoLaunchpad--tinted` | Each tile takes a hue derived from the theme's primary color, for launchpads with many destinations. Browsers without relative color syntax keep the primary color. |
| Compact rows | `amc-TBentoLaunchpad--compact` | Rows of 118px instead of 150px, for launchpads above a report. |
| Mono large tile | `amc-TBentoLaunchpad--mono` | Large tiles keep the light surface instead of a primary fill. |
| Hide big icons | `amc-TBentoLaunchpad--noGlyph` | Removes the oversized background icons and keeps the small icon chip, for dense dashboards. |
